name: rag-benchmark-dataset
description: A collection designed to evaluate retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) systems end-to-end by measuring how well retrieved context improves open‑ended question answering. The benchmark focuses on factuality, retrieval relevance, and answer correctness when models generate free‑form responses grounded in external knowledge. It is intended for comparing RAG pipelines and retrieval+generation configurations.
evaluation_method: exact_match / F1 (answer correctness) and retrieval relevance metrics
reputation: A practical community benchmark for comparing RAG pipelines with moderate adoption among retrieval+generation researchers and practitioners.
